title: Retail & Supply Chain Compliance
intro: Manufacturing, quality, and supply-chain controls are documented for qualified buyer review. Supporting records are available on request.

programs.title: Supply-chain security controls
programs.description: Security and supply-chain control records can be reviewed against the requirements of the applicable buyer program.

programs.title: Responsible sourcing controls
programs.description: Responsible-sourcing and factory-assessment records can be provided for qualified buyer review when applicable.

programs.title: Quality system controls
programs.description: Quality-system and production-control documentation can be reviewed against the requirements of the applicable buyer program.

silicaCopy: Cutting, grinding, drilling, or polishing stone can generate respirable crystalline silica dust. Fabricators must use the exact product SDS and the controls required by applicable law and work conditions.
prop65Copy: California warning and labeling information is provided for the applicable product and shipment when required.
